_comment: Declarative AutoForm layout for the Burst IRF & Background tool: a persistent dock area with the detector channel-definition page, the drop file list, burst-search + baseline parameters and the compute/send-to-MLE actions, the per-detector IRF plot and the results table.

sections.label: Min photons/burst
sections.description: Burst-search minimum photons. Photons NOT in a burst are treated as background/scatter.

sections.label: Photon window
sections.description: Sliding photon window used by the burst search to estimate the local count rate.

sections.label: Dark-count floor (quantile)
sections.description: Quantile of the non-burst micro-time histogram taken as the flat dark-count floor, subtracted before normalising the IRF.

sections.label: Micro-time binning
sections.description: Micro-time coarsening for the MLE IRF/background patterns (match the burst-MLE binning).

sections.title: IRF (non-burst scatter)
sections.description: Per-detector scatter-derived IRF from the non-burst photons (log y).
